title: Constructed comparison for one open direct-image complex
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open of $X$, and let the derived module categories on $X$ and $U$ exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $I$ be a K-injective cochain complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Write $J_U$ and $\eta_U$ for the fixed complex and unit of [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data], and $L_U$ for exact open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Let $a_U:D(L_U)\dashv Rj_{U*}$ be any supplied adjunction with the direct image of [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Define $c_U:Q(J_U)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rj_{U*}(D(L_U)(Q(I)))$ as the inverse K-injective computation isomorphism for $j_{U*}$ on $L_U(I)$, followed by $Rj_{U*}$ of the inverse exact-restriction localization comparison, and then the right-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism from the derived underived adjunction to $a_U$. The restriction complex $L_U(I)$ is K-injective, using [lem-sc-derived-k-injective-restrict-open] and the open-site equivalence.

proof.text: Restrict I on the localized open site by kInjective_of_restrict_open; the additive open-site equivalence preserves K-injective complexes by Functor.preservesKInjectiveComplexes_of_isEquivalence. This proves isKInjective_schemeOpenRestriction.

Compose the actual inverse rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso, the right-derived image of the inverse mapDerivedCategoryFactors, and the rightAdjointUniq component for the derived schemeOpenModuleAdjunction and the supplied adjunction. All three are explicit library constructions, and no arbitrary witness is chosen.

def schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (adj : (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X U I) ≅
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj
        ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))
